dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey there! Ready to go full speed ahead with Cuilein An-bot and Bar-drone Bunny?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Our two Scouting Buddies are tuned up and ready for testing!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Nice! Sure takes you back to the gliding test days, huh?

choices.text: Hope you're not juggling too many things, Collei.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Don't worry. I'm using this station as a temporary office for the Fieldwise Center as a whole.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But, it hasn't been too bad. Just a lot of data processing for our scout bots and some paperwork.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, and we also give suggestions on how to modify the internal mechanisms!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When an investigation team comes along, we register them and check if emergency training is needed. Then, we take care of the departure procedures, allocate the required personnel and equipment...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And then, we monitor the situation with their camp provisions and touch base with the logistics staff.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I don't mind. It's just temporary. The center hasn't been open for too long, so we're still working out the kinks.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yeah! Plus, verifying travel qualifications and keeping an eye on logistics is nothing new for me!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And, the Akademiya is sending specialists to set up a formal administrative team soon. We just have to show them the ropes.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Some of them are here already. So, once that's set up, and the researchers submit their certifications, we can start delegating the work.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: And then we can take a well-deserved break!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you visited other places in Sumeru?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Haha, I asked Lisa and Kaeya for some recommendations before leaving, so I have a list!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Time's been a bit tight this trip, but Collei took me around Sumeru City, and we had tons of amazing food!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: She's one busy gal, though. So, I didn't wanna drag her from place to place. It made more sense to spend time here helping her out!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I'm sorry, Amber...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: For what, haha? I'm having a blast!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Seeing you take the reins, seeing your friends place their trust in you... even rely on you... It makes me so happy!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Traveling, relaxing... I can do that whenever. It's not like this is my last time here!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Besides, once we're done, there will still be more than enough time for sight-seeing!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Th—That makes me even more determined!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: ...You don't need to worry about me, Amber! I've got this!

choices.text: I think I'll come back later.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: No rush! Whenever you're ready!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yep, we'll be here!
